summary.text: Ryan Eaves is a Republican who represents Oklahoma House District 22, which includes Atoka, Coal, Johnston and Murray counties. He was elected for the 60th Legislature and appointed vice chair of the Appropriations and Budget Finance Subcommittee.

paragraphs.text: Eaves grew up on a ranch in Atoka and has since become a businessman and rancher.
The Speaker also appointed him to the Business Committee, the Banking, Financial Services and Pensions Committee, and the Administrative Rules Committee.
His House biography lists his primary policy areas as combating inflation, reducing government overreach, and policies reflecting the priorities of rural Oklahoma.
Eaves and his wife have been married for over 20 years and have three children.
